verdict.rationale: Docs confirm native iOS, Android, and React Native SDKs (with Flutter coming later) replacing the former Onfido Smart Capture SDKks, and mention NFC/document capture integration, implying some guided capture heritage, but none of the evidence explicitly describes glare, blur, or edge-detection coaching features, nor confirms a dedicated native web SDK (web flow appears to be the no/low-code Smart Capture Link instead of an SDK). missing for 10: explicit documentation of glare/blur/edge-detection coaching UI, confirmation of a native web SDK equivalent to iOS/Android, and independent/hands-on validation of first-try capture quality.
